name: MB_GENERATED_BOXES
meaning: no BOX1-4 given: containers are created from synthesised records and added at the items' positions on delivery. Rollback only applies in this mode

name: MB_OPENED
meaning: set by msg 1; blocks re-opening and the msg 2 prompt; cleared only by Mailbox_Rollback

name: MB_COMMITTED
meaning: set by msg 0x600 (checkpoint commit) when opened; prevents rollback
